blocker.message: The byte-array view quantifies arbitrary p and retains only CharArray.full, whose cells require alignment 1; typed UShort/Ptr/Int postcondition requires alignment 2/4. Entry DataqueueStorage already provides addr_aligned(p,4), but this fact was omitted from the local view premise. Preserve it in the annotation; no stronger public Require or new ABI assumption is needed.
blocker.repair_boundary: canonical InitDataqueue.c post-memset which-implies annotation; generated files unchanged
